ops.whyShort: The modeled elemental and ogre grinds are a long camp. 2258, 710, and 782 already use those mobs.
ops.original: Do not grind rock elementals to 40 or Dustbelcher maulers to 41 as their own steps. Stop when the coyote, buzzard, shard, and Tho'grun objectives are finished.

sources.label: OpenXP 41-42 Badlands quest ids 782, 2202, 712, no separate grind step
QuestieDB 2258 needs 5 rock shards; 710 needs 10 small shards; 782 is Boss Tho'grun

ops.whyShort: Coolant Heads Prevail is frost oil, then a gyrochronatom and two potions. Nothing in the kill loop provides them.
ops.original: Skip Coolant Heads Prevail and do not pick up Gyro... What? or Liquid Stone.

ops.whyShort: 782 is the one elite kill on the Kargath loop. The follow-ups are a second elemental camp, Uldaman parts, and two level 50 elementals.
ops.original: Turn in Broken Alliances and take Report to Helgrum for the flight to Stonard. Do not accept the second Broken Alliances, the rest of Study of the Elements: Rock, or Uldaman Reagent Run.

ops.whyShort: Twenty pirate hats are a rare-drop stack. The shipment crate does not need them.
ops.original: Skip Pirate Hats Ahoy! Kill the Southsea counts for Southsea Shakedown while you loot Stoley's Shipment.

sources.label: QuestieDB 8365 objective is 20 Southsea Pirate Hats; 8366 is kill counts; 2873 is one shipment

ops.whyShort: The Tanaris homing robot is a long escort. The beacon is optional loot, not a planned step.
ops.original: If the OOX-17/TN distress beacon drops, leave it. Do not start the escort.

ops.whyShort: Screecher spirits are a Feralas objective with no turn-in on the route, and the follow-up is a Zul'Farrak tablet pair.
ops.original: Skip Screecher Spirits. Do not add The Prophecy of Mosh'aru.

sources.label: QuestieDB 3520 next 3527; objective is 3 screecher spirits

ops.whyShort: Deliver to MacKinley ends in Booty Bay. This route never goes back there after the port.
ops.original: Turn in Stoley's Shipment at Steamwheedle Port and do not take Deliver to MacKinley.

sources.label: QuestieDB 2874 pre 2873, ends at MacKinley in Booty Bay

ops.whyShort: Oasis walks the quenched turtle back across the desert. That escort is longer than the turn-in.
ops.original: Skip Oasis. Do not escort the turtle to Torta.

sources.label: QuestieDB 97540 objective is to lead Tooga back to Torta; turn-in pin is Tanaris 31.8, 74.2

ops.whyShort: These four quests are level 60: a duel quota, a Winterspring handoff, and two mech errands.
ops.original: Skip Field of Honor: Week 1, Frosty Favors, Beach Bot, and Mechanical Romance on the 40-50 pass.

ops.whyShort: The dew gland drops in the same valley as the thistleshrub kills. The quest after the town talk leaves Tanaris.
ops.original: Turn in The Thirsty Goblin at Marin. In Good Taste is only the talk to Sprinkle in Gadgetzan. Do not take Sprinkle's Secret Ingredient.

sources.label: QuestieDB 2605 next 2606; 2606 pre 2605 next 2641; 2641 is a violet tragan

ops.whyShort: Consolation Prize turns in at Powderfuse Port. The port boat is the ride, and that landing is not a Riverglades quest loop.
ops.original: The free boat at Steamwheedle Port returns to Powderfuse Port. Take it when Consolation Prize is in the bag, turn that quest in, and do not pick up other Riverglades quests there.

sources.label: QuestieDB 95472 pre 95321; turn-in goto is map 2548 at 77.1, 52.9
WoW-Pro Horde chapter 3 uses Tanaris map 1446 for the Steamwheedle turn-ins

ops.whyShort: Zul'Farrak is one clear when a group is already there. Tablet quests and an instance script are a second project.
ops.original: One Zul'Farrak clear is enough if a group is forming. Do not run a dungeon script, and do not stay for tablet quests.

sources.label: QuestieDB 3527 pre 3520 and asks for the two Mosh'aru tablets
Bethink 42-44 treats Uldaman as its own dungeon visit, separate from the outdoor loop

ops.whyShort: On the Other Side is turned in at Camp Mojache during the Riverglades stretch, then the route flies there again after Tanaris.
ops.original: Carry On the Other Side from Riverglades and turn it in to Witch Doctor Uzer'i on the Camp Mojache landing, before the Woodpaw and Gordunni accepts. The Shadowprey alternate does not pass this turn-in.

sources.label: QuestieDB 95033 has no pre; turn-in is Uzer'i, map 1444 at 74.4, 43.4
OpenXP 41-42 Feralas opens at Camp Mojache with 2987, 2975, and 2862

ops.whyShort: Ten thick yeti hides are a hide farm, and the follow-up is ten Rage Scar hides.
ops.original: Skip The Mark of Quality and Improved Quality.

ops.whyShort: Sprite darter wings are a camp, and the follow-up is twenty grimtotem horns plus an Orgrimmar crate.
ops.original: Skip A New Cloak's Sheen and both A Grim Discovery quests.

ops.whyShort: Twenty carapaces are a bug stack. The report needs that stack and Stinglasher, and it is the Horde lead-in to March of the Silithid.
ops.original: Skip Zukk'ash Infestation, Stinglasher, and Zukk'ash Report. March of the Silithid then has no Horde prerequisite from this pass.

sources.label: QuestieDB 7730 and 7731 pre 2903; 7732 pre group 7730 and 7731; 4494 pre.single 32 or 7732

ops.whyShort: The Forgotten Coast pair is 10 elemental cores plus 15 shrinker residues on giants.
ops.original: Skip Fuel for the Zapping and Zapped Giants.

sources.label: QuestieDB 7003 is 15 miniaturization residues; 7721 is 10 water elemental cores

ops.whyShort: The Feralas homing robot is a long escort from a random beacon.
ops.original: If the OOX-22/FE distress beacon drops, leave it. Do not start the escort.

ops.whyShort: A Strange Request is accepted and never turned in. The return quest opens the muisek chain.
ops.original: Do not accept A Strange Request from Witch Doctor Uzer'i.

ops.whyShort: Horde March of the Silithid needs the Zukk'ash report. This pass drops that report.
ops.original: Do not accept March of the Silithid on this pass. Its Horde prerequisite is Zukk'ash Report, and that chain was dropped. The Alliance-style prerequisite 32 does not replace it.
